finalText:
All objectives complete. Final report:

1. **DONE** — Ticket `RD-1015` titled **"fwrd87-n1 RD Bench Ticket"** exists (customer Marlow Bakery, raised 2026-09-23, created in Draft status, detail page at `#/tickets/t15`).
2. **DONE** — Part **"fwrd87-n1 RD Part A"** with cost $100.00 and markup 25% → app-computed price **$125.00**.
3. **DONE** — Part **"fwrd87-n1 RD Part B"** with cost $200.00 and markup 25% → app-computed price **$250.00** (parts total was $375.00 at that point).
4. **DONE** — Part A's cost changed from 100 to 150 (markup unchanged 25%) → app-computed price **$187.50** (parts total $437.50).
5. **DONE** — Ticket ended in status **Ready**. Precondition discovered: the first "Mark Ready" attempt was rejected with the error text *"Ticket is not ready — Part 'fwrd87-n1 RD Part A' has no supplier — Part 'fwrd87-n1 RD Part B' has no supplier"*. Required: **every part on the ticket must have a supplier**. I set supplier "Bench Supplies Ltd" on both parts via each row's Edit dialog, then "Mark Ready" succeeded — header showed "Status: Ready" and actions changed to "Mark Draft" / "Mark Closed".
6. **DONE** — Both parts were deleted (each via a Confirm dialog → "Delete part"); the parts table then showed the empty state "No parts on this ticket yet." with no rows and no total. The ticket was then archived via the "Archive ticket" button (button flipped to "Unarchive ticket", header showed "Ready / Archived"). The default tickets list now shows "Showing 1–10 of 13" with RD-1015 absent; only with "Show archived" ticked does RD-1015 appear, with an "Archived" badge. Nothing created by this run remains active.
